study: F2 WP2.3 slice 1 - two-way range station bias solve-for in BLS-LM (MEAS-08, X-15 bias part)
source_of_predeclaration: docs/assurance/vv-program.md F2 table (WP2.3 row); plan section 9 design 2026-11-03
scope_slice_1: estimate_two_way_range_bls_lm(bias_mode='station_range'): one constant range bias per station of the pass, data-only, eliminated exactly by variable projection (Golub-Pereyra; the bias enters linearly with a constant design column): residual and Jacobian rows of each station have their a-priori-weighted station mean removed, so the LM loop, its acceptance test and the posterior (the Schur-complement marginal of the orbit state) are unchanged in form. The bias estimates are reported in EstimatorStats.station_range_biases_m. Moon-centred and barycentric (two_way_light_time_ssb) passes alike
out_of_scope_slice_1: robust outlier rejection with bias (fails closed)

G1_bias_recovery.rule: noise-free data with known biases +7 m (station 1) and -4 m (station 2): recovered biases within 1 mm

G2_state_recovery.rule: position < 1 cm from an 80 m / 0.02 m/s offset, on the same data

G3_bias_free_model_misfit.rule: the same data fitted without bias_mode leaves a station-mean residual within 2 m of the injected bias on at least one station (evidence the bias is material)

G4_projection_identity.rule: on unbiased data, bias_mode='station_range' returns biases < 1 mm and a state within 1 cm of the bias-free solve

G5_fail_closed.rule: SRIF with bias_mode, bias_mode with solve_for_k_srp, with robust_outlier_rejection, and unknown bias_mode values are rejected; a pass with a single station row is rejected

amendments.new_rule: after removing the first-order frame term Delta_M3 (u_up . v_Moon,SSB)/c the rows agree within 1.5 mm (measured 1.03 mm)
FD step 10 m / 1e-2 m/s, threshold unchanged (measured 7.5e-8)

amendments.as_computed: materiality clause FAIL (0.28 m post-fit RMS; 187 m absorbed position error); recovery clause PASS
amendments.new_rule: zero-delay fit position error > 10 m and post-fit RMS > 1000x the matched fit

amendments.as_computed: the delay is rejected earlier, at RangeRatePhysicsConfig (ValueError)
FAIL (0.088 m pass-mean residual; 676 m absorbed position error)
amendments.new_rule: station-mode fit position error > 10 m and post-fit RMS > 1000x the pass-mode fit

reject_if: any gate fails as computed, or a frozen default-path baseline changes
scope_slice_1b: estimate_two_way_range_srif(bias_mode='station_range'): the same variable projection in the SRIF residual, scored cost and posterior design; SRIF no longer fails closed for this mode (G5's SRIF clause is superseded by G6)

G6_srif_parity.rule: on the G1 data SRIF recovers the biases within 1 mm and its state agrees with BLS-LM within 1 cm; SRIF and BLS-LM posterior position sigmas agree within 1 percent

scope_slice_2: two_way_light_time_ssb with a nonzero fixed transponder delay d (delay-calibrated half-round-trip convention, as the Moon-centred M3 'fixed_coordinate_time' model): relativistic_light_time.solve_two_way takes transponder_delay_s; the uplink is received at the spacecraft at t2u = t2d - d (a local delay, never an epoch difference), the delay-calibrated range is 0.5 c (tau_down + tau_up)(1 - dD/dt) and the measured interval t3 - t1 = tau_down + d + tau_up sets the midpoint rate epoch; the event partials take the spacecraft position sensitivity and velocity at t2u for the uplink. _pass_context and the scenario loader accept d > 0 with this convention; the raw convention and barycentric counted Doppler with a delay still fail closed

G7_zero_delay_identity.rule: transponder_delay_s=0 reproduces the slice-1 SSB ranges and Jacobian bitwise

G8_delay_effect_parity_with_M3.rule: on the G1 arc with d = 0.05 s, the per-row range change SSB(d) - SSB(0) agrees with the Moon-centred M3 change M3(d) - M3(0) within 1 mm, and the change exceeds 1 m on at least one row

G9_jacobian_fd.rule: the d = 0.05 s range Jacobian matches a central finite difference of the initial state (position step 1 m, velocity step 1e-3 m/s) within 1e-6 relative to the row norm

G10_bls_recovery.rule: BLS-LM on noise-free d = 0.05 s data with the matching model recovers position within 1 cm from the G2 offset; a model with d = 0 leaves an RMS residual above 0.5 m on the same data

G11_fail_closed.rule: the scenario loader accepts transponder_delay_s > 0 with two_way_light_time_ssb, still rejects the raw convention; barycentric counted Doppler with a delay still raises NotImplementedError

results_slice_2.G7: PASS bitwise vs HEAD edc8a0b on 240 rows (ranges and Jacobian)

scope_slice_3: bias_mode='pass_range' in estimate_two_way_range_bls_lm and estimate_two_way_range_srif: one constant range bias per tracking pass, eliminated by the same variable projection as 'station_range'. A pass is a run of one station's rows (time order) with no gap above TWO_WAY_RANGE_PASS_GAP_S = 600 s; passes are numbered from 1 per station. Bias estimates are reported in EstimatorStats.station_range_biases_m keyed by (station id, pass index). Same fail-closed rules as slice 1 (K_SRP, robust rejection, a pass with fewer than two rows)

G12_pass_bias_recovery.rule: noise-free SSB data, station 1 tracked in two passes (0-1200 s, 2400-3600 s) with biases +6 m / -3 m, station 2 one pass with +2 m: BLS-LM and SRIF recover every pass bias within 1 mm and position within 1 cm from the G2 offset

G13_station_model_misfit.rule: the same data fitted with bias_mode='station_range' leave a pass-mean residual magnitude above 1 m on at least one station-1 pass

G14_constant_bias_consistency.rule: on data with station-constant biases (+7 m / -4 m) on the same two-pass geometry, 'pass_range' returns both station-1 pass biases within 1 mm of +7 m

G15_fail_closed.rule: a pass with a single row is rejected; 'pass_range' with solve_for_k_srp or robust_outlier_rejection is rejected; the station-mode behaviour (G1-G6) is unchanged

results_slice_3.G12: PASS (BLS-LM and SRIF, every pass bias within 0.17 mm, position 0.25 mm)
